styles.name: hurricane
styles.description: Spiral arms rotate around a calm eye; intensity and radius grow with progress

styles.name: tornado
styles.description: Tapering funnel widens toward the ground; debris particles orbit the vortex

styles.name: snow-accumulation
styles.description: Snowflakes drift downward while a snowdrift pile rises from the bottom with progress

styles.name: hailstorm
styles.description: Dense hailstones streak straight down and bounce on impact; density ramps with progress

styles.name: rainbow-arc
styles.description: Concentric rainbow arcs appear band by band from the horizon as progress grows

styles.name: fog-roll-in
styles.description: Dense fog rolls in from the left; the leading edge thickens with a shade-glyph gradient

styles.name: barometer
styles.description: Analog pressure gauge: a needle sweeps from STORMY to FAIR as progress rises

styles.name: wind-sock
styles.description: A windsock cone extends as gusts blow; streak lines visualise airspeed

styles.name: blizzard-whiteout
styles.description: Visibility collapses into whiteout: shade density ramps to full as progress reaches 1

styles.name: cumulonimbus
styles.description: A cloud tower builds upward into a thunderhead, then rain streaks fall below

styles.name: frost-crystals
styles.description: Dendritic frost crystals propagate inward from the edges; branching depth grows with progress

styles.name: thermometer
styles.description: Mercury column rises in a thermometer tube; bulb glows at bottom, tick marks show scale
